method: Each source's pubspec.yaml, lib/ Dart sources, README and referenced assets were read on disk; verdicts come from code, not README claims. No source was modified.

user_policy.rule_private: Sources whose business depends on a private backend service are skipped and their directories are kept (original user rule).
user_policy.rule_no_business: User chose: static UI demos are migrated into the host as demo modules (preserving their real data and interactions, following the Messenger and zhihu-flutter precedent) and only then retired. Sources with no real business, plugin packages, and native-blocked sources are KEPT, because retiring them would destroy code that was never migrated.
user_policy.rule_dart_simple_live: User chose: dart_simple_live is skipped strictly and its directory is kept, even though only one optional remote-sync screen depends on the author's server.
user_policy.delete_scope: Only sources whose real business is verifiably present in the host may be retired: MIGRATE sources after host verification, STATIC_DEMO sources after their demo module lands, and DUPLICATE_ONLY sources once their canonical source is in the host.

cross_cutting_findings: The anime/comic domain contains zero private backends; every 192.168.x/127.0.0.1 hit there is a settings hint, a proxy-error comment, or a commented-out dev packet-capture proxy.
Five anime/comic sources put all real business in Rust/Go behind flutter_rust_bridge or gomobile; jasmine's native backend is not even present in the checkout.
Three reading sources share one source-engine concept (eso, EasyMyGo, and book's engine); only one host target should be chosen.
Two movie sources implement eyepetizer and three implement TMDb; duplicates should collapse to one canonical source each.
No movie source uses media_kit; every MIGRATE there needs its player swapped (better_player, fijkplayer, chewie, video_player_win, native tencentplayer).
flutter_read's working tree is NUL-corrupted and its git index is unreadable; any future read must recover blobs via git cat-file.
